brief:
The commander of U.S. Central Command visited Israel as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu urges Washington to resume major combat operations against Iran, Al-Monitor reported. The visit follows recent exchanges of fire between Israel and Tehran and ongoing threats of further escalation in the region.

Israeli officials have intensified diplomatic pressure on the United States to authorize renewed military action against Iranian targets. The discussions center on Iran's nuclear program and regional military capabilities.
dek: The visit comes as Israeli officials, led by Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, press Washington to resume major combat operations against Iran.
title: CENTCOM chief visits Israel as Netanyahu presses U.S. on Iran strikes
